answer: Trust-flow limiting: a few long-standing agents, each a relic of honest history, seed credit that spreads along vouches but is capped at every edge. Clones of one attacker cluster on a single mesa with few links to honest nodes, so all their credit squeezes through that narrow cut. A thousand fakes gain almost nothing, and buying real vouches costs real reputation, like a sonnet whose rhyme scheme cannot be faked cheaply.
